settings.name: Click Title to Open Player
settings.tip:
Clicking the title opens the app that is playing.
Try: On.

settings.name: Tooltips (Spotify)
settings.tip:
Hover the strip's buttons while Spotify plays: Previous shows the song played before, Play/Pause the song playing with its time left counting down, Next the next song in Spotify's queue (read from Spotify's window while you hover; it shows when Spotify's queue sidebar does). Styled like the right-click menu's panels (Panel Colours, Panel Glass, Menu Font). Nothing goes online.
Try: on.

settings.name: Tooltip Delay (ms)
settings.tip: How long the pointer rests on a button before its tooltip shows, 0 to 3000. 0: at once.

settings.name: Tooltip Gap (px)
settings.tip: Between the strip and its tooltip, 0 to 64.

settings.name: Tooltip Padding (px)
settings.tip: Inside the tooltip, round its text, 0 to 48.

settings.name: Backdrop
settings.tip:
What's behind the card or buttons.
Solid: the background colour as set.
Clear: no fill, floating on the desktop (it still takes clicks).
Blur: the desktop behind it blurred, tinted by the background colour.
Acrylic: frosted glass, tinted the same way.
Try: Acrylic for frosted glass, Clear to float.

settings.name: Enabled
settings.tip:
A panel behind the visualizer.
Try: On.

settings.name: Color
settings.tip:
The panel's colour. Lower the alpha to see the wallpaper through it.
Try: #60000000 for a soft dark panel, fully clear to hide it.

settings.name: Padding
settings.tip:
The space between the bars and the panel's edge. One number, or four for left, right, top, bottom.
Try: 4 for snug, 24 for roomy.

settings.name: Corner Radius
settings.tip:
How round the panel's corners are.
Try: 0 for square, 14 for soft.

settings.name: Blur
settings.tip:
Blurs the wallpaper behind the panel, like frosted glass.
Try: 10.

settings.name: Border Size
settings.tip:
An outline around the panel. 0 is none.
Try: 1.

settings.name: Border Color
settings.tip:
The colour of the panel's outline.
Try: #64AA89.

settings.name: Target FPS
settings.tip:
How many times a second the visualizer redraws. Higher is smoother and uses a bit more power.
Try: 60, or 0 to match your screen.

settings.name: Pause On Fullscreen
settings.tip:
Stops drawing while a game or video is fullscreen.
Try: On.

settings.name: Pause When Silent (seconds)
settings.tip:
After this many seconds of silence, the visualizer nearly stops drawing to save power.
Try: 5.

settings.name: Deep Idle
settings.tip:
Shortly after going quiet, stops listening to the sound entirely so the PC can sleep, waking when sound plays.
Try: On.

settings.name: Performance Stats
settings.tip:
Writes what the visualizer costs to the log every 30 seconds.
Try: Off unless you're checking performance.

settings.name: Auto-Hide When Idle
settings.tip:
Fades the whole visualizer out after a stretch of silence.
Try: On for a clean desktop when nothing plays.

settings.name: Auto-Hide Delay (seconds)
settings.tip:
How many seconds of silence before it fades out.
Try: 7.5.

settings.name: Show Over Living Wallpapers
settings.tip: With Tourne Desktop's living wallpaper running, the visualizer and the lyrics stay in front of it. The wallpaper paints the desktop's icons' layer, so while it runs they're in front of the icons too (still click-through). Off: hidden behind it, as before.

settings.name: Show While Stepped Away
settings.tip: While Tourne Desktop's Step away is up (with its living wallpaper as the screensaver too), the visualizer and the lyrics show in front of it, click-through; any input brings the screens back as usual. Never over the lock screen's curtain.

settings.name: Pause When Covered
settings.tip:
Stops drawing while windows cover the visualizer.
Try: On.

settings.name: Pause When Covered - Threshold
settings.tip:
How much of the visualizer has to be under windows before it stops drawing to save power: from 5% (stops as soon as a window touches it) to 100% (only when fully hidden).
Try: 55 to save power without stopping while it's mostly visible.

settings.name: Workload
options: GPU - analysis and drawing on the GPU
settings.tip:
Which chip does the work.
Hybrid: the processor measures the sound, the graphics card draws; cheapest on almost every PC.
GPU: the graphics card does both; the processor only copies audio.
CPU: the processor does everything, drawing included.
NPU: an Intel AI chip measures the sound (experimental, rarely saves power).
Try: Hybrid.

settings.name: Drawing Device
settings.tip:
Which graphics chip draws.
Auto: the one your monitor is plugged into (best almost always).
Integrated: the built-in chip, lowest power.
Discrete: the graphics card, highest performance.
CPU: drawn in software.
Try: Auto.

settings.name: Renderer
settings.tip:
How the visualizer is drawn.
Direct3D 11: fast, skips frames where nothing moved, and needed for glow, bloom, glass and outlines.
Direct2D: the older 1.5 way, kept for comparison and as a fallback.
Try: Direct3D 11.

settings.name: Opaque Panel
settings.tip:
With a fully solid panel (or Blur on) and Auto-Hide off, lets Windows skip blending behind it to save work.
Auto: does that when it can.
Off: always blends.
Try: Auto.

settings.name: NPU Runtime Folder
settings.tip:
Where the NPU software lives, for Workload set to NPU.
Try: leave empty.

settings.name: Smooth Mode (2.1 pacing)
settings.tip: 2.1's frame pacing, kept as it was.

settings.name: Frame Sync
options: Auto (VSync on integrated GPU or CPU drawing)
Adaptive (VSync up to the refresh rate, uncapped above)
settings.tip:
How frames line up with your screen's refresh.
Auto: VSync on integrated graphics or CPU drawing, otherwise Off.
Off: a plain timer at Target FPS, any value.
VSync: every frame on its own refresh, capped at the refresh rate; smoothest.
Adaptive: VSync up to the refresh rate, uncapped above.
Fast Sync: uncapped, always showing the newest frame.

settings.name: Low Latency
settings.tip:
How close to the screen's refresh each frame is drawn (with Frame Sync or Smooth Mode on); closer means bars react sooner.
Off: half a refresh ahead, safest.
On: a quarter refresh ahead.
Ultra: just in time, measured on this PC; the least delay.
Try: On for snappier bars.

settings.name: Frame Generation
settings.tip:
Draws an in-between frame for every two real ones.
Off: every frame measured and drawn.
x2: the sound is measured at half the rate and halfway frames fill in; less work, one frame more delay.
Try: Off.

settings.name: Engine Cores
settings.tip:
Which processor cores run the visualizer.
Auto: Windows decides.
Efficiency: the low-power cores; least power.
Performance: the fast cores; steadiest timing.
Custom: the cores listed in Custom Cores.
Try: Efficiency on a laptop, Auto otherwise.

settings.name: Custom Cores
settings.tip:
The exact processor cores to use, with Engine Cores set to Custom.
Try: leave empty.
